item.title: Assassination Attempt on Farooq Abdullah Foiled in Jammu, Gunman Arrested
item.description: GUWAHATI: Veteran politician and National Conference president Farooq Abdullah narrowly escaped an assassination attempt after a gunman opened fire at close range during a wedding function in Jammu on the evening of Wednesday, March 11. The attacker was quickly overpowered by security personnel and taken into custody, officials said. item.title: “Nobody Will Give Them Jobs”: Supreme Court Rejects PIL on Menstrual Leave
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Supreme Court on Friday, March 13, refused to entertain a public interest litigation (PIL) seeking a nationwide policy granting menstrual leave to women students and employees, while cautioning that making such a provision mandatory could unintentionally reinforce gender stereotypes and affect women’s employment prospects.
